replies.body:
Ok first of all:
1) I spent a year on ocn and mumble cuz I didn't know mczone changed into avicus.
2) I'm not generalising/discriminating, I have decent knowledge of most ocn clans that come here. 
But honestly, although I know Ocn teams will really chill people (Slithering Shadows and others), many ocn teams are really rude when it comes to scrims. Not saying all, but I can assure it and I have evidence of this. I'm not going to say it publicity here, (if you want to see it talk to me on skype.)
Because you have a good reputation on ocn and this team is really OP, I know you guys aren't here just to snipe the prize and claim the glory and rub it in our faces. But honestly, out of all the ocn clans i've scrimmed many of them tend to be rude and are here for the humiliation.
